headline: Slippery Rock end Gannon's unbeaten run
dek: Slippery Rock won at Gannon, the first side to beat them since Lake Erie did on the same ground in the opening match. Slippery Rock had lost the earlier meeting between the two at home. The defeat is Gannon's second of the season, against ten wins and three draws.
displaced_by: Slippery Rock beat Gannon at home, so the standing headline that Gannon have not lost since their opening match is no longer true

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Gannon have scored more than California (Pa.) and West Chester together and conceded 18, so the tallest bar stands on attack: theirs is a lead in goals scored, not in goals kept out.

wire.line: Jaden Howard has kept seven shutouts in goal for West Chester.
